title: Build a world that defeats a rule

hard_stop: Stop at explicit finite models before discussing arbitrary structures or metatheorems.

title: The list that cannot catch your pattern

title: The largest collection with no nested sets
entry: O: recognize which pictured objects belong to each card; no arithmetic beyond small counts.
hard_stop: Stop at the exact four-object optimum if the general combinatorial proof is not accessible.
status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Send a whole tree in two numbers

title: How many minimal networks survive?

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: When the usual mixing rule breaks

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Everything your starting clues force
entry: O: place named tokens and follow one visible if-then rule.

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Which numbers may share a name?
entry: O and C: use a supplied four-by-four addition table or move on a four-position ring.

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Two clocks, one hidden position
entry: O and C: move two counters once for each shared step and recognize paired positions.

title: Square dots that also make a triangle

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: A cube that ruler and compass cannot double

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: The monomials that survive the forbidden corners

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: A nonzero symbol whose square vanishes
entry: A and F: distribute two linear expressions and add signed rational coefficients.
hard_stop: This is an algebra-gated investigation. Do not replace the relation with 'ε is almost zero' to lower the prerequisite.
status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Find every rational point by aiming a line

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: A curve made of seven finite-field points

hard_stop: Finish with the seven affine points when projective coordinates are unavailable; do not quietly add an unexplained eighth point.
status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: The average stays, the disagreement shrinks

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Stretch, shear, flatten: what happens to area?

hard_stop: General volume scaling in higher dimension or change of variables requires additional algebra/analysis, not merely many drawings.
status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Take one linear arrow apart

hard_stop: Keep a genuine linear-algebra gate. A token-routing analogy is only motivation until linear combinations and basis changes are present.
status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Measure how matrix moves fail to commute

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: The collection that remembers both choices

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Which loops can face moves erase?

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Can the order of two turns change the result?

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Can opposite fence heights always be different?

title: Can infinitely many points fit under very short covers?

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Follow a square root around a circle

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: How much does an addition machine have to reveal?

status: reviewed plan v1; exact instance checked; not classroom-piloted

title: Two different motions with the same snapshots
